title: Writing --- Four Lines That Hold Together
label: ch:escribir-cuatro-lineas
canDo: I can write four connected lines to a named reader about what I did yesterday, using y to add and porque to give a reason, so that a line depends on the one before it.

payoff.summary: Complete ES-W02-cuatro-lineas-ayer: four lines to one named reader, at least one joined with y and at least one with porque, then cover line one and check line two still needs it.
payoff.note: The stage after controlled composition in the HL16 ramp, and the one Spanish had never proven: a reader can be named, sentences can depend on each other, and the check is whether line two survives covering line one.
